scope: All 26 eligible Reviewed additions assigned to bounded batch a.
methodology: Every assigned record was compared to the actual public maintainer advisory structured fields and description prose; no proof of concept or source code was executed.

API and HTML response originals remain local only. Public artifacts contain allowlisted fields, independently written observations, response hashes and selected public headers, never full descriptions, code, credits, private-report links or tracking metadata.

Literal package coordinates, affected and fixed strings and source timestamps are preserved independently. CVSS numeric scores are copied only when published, never computed. HTML missing timestamps are marked unobservable, not asserted null source values.
limitations: This is a delta review, not a fresh primary-source review of the full corpus.
GitHub unauthenticated API rate limits required HTML fallback; individual failed attempts and successful HTML evidence are separate.
No independent KEV or real-world exploitation verification was performed.
Source-level range conflicts do not imply a local dependency applicability verdict.
